values.products-description:
A lightweight cape in charcoal ripstop nylon with a 10,000 mm waterproof coating and taped seams. It is cut long and wide enough to cover you and a bag on your back, and it vents at the sides so you do not boil in it.

Packed, it rolls into a stuff sack the size of a coffee cup. A hood with a stiffened brim keeps rain off glasses.

The first run sold through in a week. The next arrives in the autumn.

products-image1.products-image1-alt: Folded charcoal rain cape beside its stuff sack

products-spec.products-spec-care: Rinse and hang to dry; do not tumble
products-spec.products-spec-material: Recycled ripstop nylon, PU coated; taped seams
products-spec.products-spec-warranty: Two years on seams and coating

values.products-subtitle: A charcoal cape that folds into its own sack and covers a bag.
